    Why did Boca Juniors get suspended?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    A recent Boca Juniors game was suspended due to a lightning storm during their 2025 Club World Cup match against Auckland City in Nashville, Tennessee, forcing players off the field for safety. While the match was paused, news broke that their elimination from the tournament was mathematically sealed by another result, making the continuation somewhat pointless for their advancement, though the game was eventually completed. 
    This video shows a different match of Boca Juniors being suspended due to a tragic event:
    35s
    Cadena 3 Argentina
    YouTube · Oct 8, 2025
    Key Details:
    • When: June 24, 2025. 
    • What: The match against Auckland City was halted in the second half. 
    • Why: Severe weather, specifically a lightning storm, near the stadium posed a safety risk, leading to suspension under FIFA protocols. 
    • Outcome: Even with the match tied 1-1, Boca Juniors was eliminated from the tournament as Benfica won their concurrent match, ending Boca's qualification hopes. 
    Other Notable Suspensions (Historical Context):
    • 2018 Copa Libertadores Final:
      The second leg against River Plate was postponed and later moved from Buenos Aires after River fans attacked the Boca team bus, injuring players with projectiles and tear gas. 
    • March 2024:
      A match against Estudiantes was suspended after a seizure on the pitch by Boca's Javier Herrera.

      What does Boca junior mean in English?
      After several names were proposed, "Boca" (for the neighborhood) was chosen, adding "Juniors" to it after a suggestion by Sana, to highlight to name.
